player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id} emdlalweni wabadlali abathathu we-Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma. Umdlalo uthatha imizuliswano {num_rounds}. Isakhiwo somjikelezo: • {conv_rounds} ukuphenduka kwamahhala kwezingxoxo • 1 ukuphenduka kokunquma - thumela ithokheni elilodwa kumphikisi ngamunye: '[<opp-id> cooperate]' noma '[<opp-id> defect]' (okungukuthi '[1 defect] [2 cooperate]'; okuzenzakalelayo 'bambisana'). I-matrix yokukhokha ngokuhlakanipha kwe-pair (esetshenziswa kulowo nalowo mbhangqwana ongalungiswanga): - Bobabili babambisana -> {reward} - Bobabili banamaphutha -> {punishment} - Uyahluleka, bayabambisana -> {temptation} - Uyabambisana, bayaphutha -> {sucker} Umdlali) onamaphuzu aphezulu ekugcineni kwayo yonke imizuliswano uyaphumelela.

round.start: ─── Ukuqala Umjikelezo {round} ─── Ungakhuluma ngokukhululeka emizuzwini elandelayo {conv_rounds}.
round.chat_finished: Chat finished for round {round}. Submit your decisions, one token per opponent: `[pid cooperate]` or `[pid defect]`.

results.pair_line: {observation} Umdlali {i} vs Umdlali {j} ukhethe {choice_i} no {choice_j} ngokulandelana (Umdlali {i} uthole {gain_i}, Umdlali {j} uthole {gain_j})

outcome.final: Amaphuzu okugcina: {scores}. Amaqembu okubalwa (okubi kakhulu→okuhle kakhulu): {groups}
